title: tune-nccl-collectives-kvcache-overlap-tensor-parallel
author: Ethan Park
description:
Motivation: improve multi-GPU tensor-parallel serving latency and throughput by increasing overlap between NCCL collectives and device compute, and by reducing KV-cache stalls during continuous batching. Changes introduce prioritized CUDA/NCCL streams for async collectives, a small async wrapper for KV-cache uploads that overlaps host->device copies with compute, and scheduling hints to the kernel launcher to avoid unnecessary stream synchronization. This PR bundles microbenchmarks, unit tests, and a runtime telemetry patch to validate behavior.

Summary of changes: added prioritized NCCL stream support and stream pool, async NVLink-/PCIe-aware KV-cache uploader, cooperative kernel scheduling to reduce cudaStreamSynchronize calls, and small heuristic tuning for collective chunk sizing and all-reduce pipeline depth. Also added opt-in runtime flag `--tp-nccl-optimize` and continued support for fallback behavior when the driver does not expose stream priority.

Impact: on internal 8xA100 TP experiments this change reduces p50 latency for 2k token sequences by ~18% and improves throughput by ~12% under mixed request sizes. Memory impact is modest (+120MB per GPU for pinned staging buffers) and is disabled behind the runtime flag.

Testing: unit tests for async KV uploader and stream pool, integration perf runs in perf lab, cross-checks with existing KV-cache regression prompts, and CI matrix covering CUDA 11.8/12.1 where relevant.

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps changes focused to runtime scheduling and does not modify attention kernel math paths. Follow-up work will evaluate further kernel fusion opportunities once scheduling wins are validated.

d4e5f6a: async kv-cache uploader (host->device staging with pinned buffers)
b7c8d9e: cooperative kernel scheduler to reduce stream syncs

changed_files_summary: Add stream pool and priority abstraction, implement async KV-cache uploader with pinned staging buffers, reduce explicit stream synchronizations in launch manager, add perf tests and telemetry counters, update docs and CI compatibility check.
benchmarks: 8xA100 internal perf lab: baseline vs PR: throughput +12% (steady-state), p50 latency -18% at 2k tokens, p95 latency -9%. Mixed-size workload (1-2k tokens) saw 8-11% throughput gain. Memory overhead: ~120MB/GPU for pinned staging buffers.
review_comments: Laura Chen: Can you add a safety guard for drivers that don't expose stream priorities? We should fallback to default streams without regressions.
Miguel Torres: The async uploader looks good but please add a stress test that simulates a KV cache miss storm to validate pinned buffer recycling under high churn.
Priya Raman: Please ensure telemetry includes per-GPU overlap percentage and stall reasons so SRE can tune autoscaling thresholds.
Laura Chen: Suggest adding an opt-out flag at per-route level in case some customers want deterministic single-stream behavior.
author_replies: Ethan Park: Added driver fallback (checks driver API) and made optimization behind --tp-nccl-optimize. If driver doesn't support priority we fall back to regular streams; behavior is documented.
Ethan Park: Added stress test to tests/perf and added a simple buffer pool leak check. Results included in perf artifacts.
Ethan Park: Added telemetry counters: nccl_overlap_pct, kv_upload_stall_ms, kv_upload_bytes_pending. Exposed through /metrics and console dashboard will surface these under 'tp/overlap'.
Ethan Park: Per-route opt-out was discussed; added a runtime config knob that Platform teams can set per-route. Docs updated with examples.
merge_outcome: Merged to main after approvals; no rollbacks observed in canary
release_notes: Runtime: improve NCCL collectives and KV-cache overlap for tensor-parallel serving. Opt-in via --tp-nccl-optimize. Expected throughput uplift and lower latency under multi-GPU workloads. See docs/perf/tuning-nccl.md for rollout guidance.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind runtime flag; rollout guidance in docs includes CI checks and perf gate thresholds. Monitor nccl_overlap_pct and kv_upload_stall_ms and disable if overlap drops below configured threshold. Pinning buffers increases host memory usage by ~120MB/GPU.
internal_follow_up: Evaluate kernel fusion and further attention-kernel scheduling once telemetry stabilizes; track under ENG-5321.
human_summary: This PR tunes NCCL collectives, adds prioritized streams and an async KV-cache uploader to increase overlap of communication and compute for tensor-parallel multi-GPU serving. Benchmarks show meaningful throughput and latency improvements; changes are opt-in and include tests, telemetry, and docs.
